text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hi! You okay, Ace? You look<n>exhausted!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, because it's my birthday! I just<n>did a lap
around the whole school.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I've got these special rules I made<n>for myself. One
is to time a run at full<n>speed around the academy on
my<n>birthday.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Another is to beat last year's time,<n>every time!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become even better than I<n>was last
year! And my birthday's the<n>perfect day to mark
that!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Whistle... Awesome! That kind ofthing really suits you, Ace!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Haha! I knew coming all the way here<n>to meet you
was the right call!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did you need something from<n>me?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Ace of Japan—I just<n>wanted to tell
you that!
